title: CLIP: Connecting Text and Images
summary: OpenAI published its CLIP milestone on January 5, 2021, introducing Contrastive Language–Image Pre-training as a neural network that learns visual concepts from natural-language supervision and can be applied to visual classification tasks by specifying category names in natural language.
significance: A documented multimodal-learning milestone connecting natural-language supervision with transferable visual recognition and zero-shot evaluation.

verification.note: The January 5 2021 milestone date, CLIP name, natural-language-supervision description, zero-shot visual-classification framing, and listed OpenAI milestone authors are supported directly by OpenAI's first-party CLIP page. The date is attached only to that documented public milestone; no internal training-completion date, geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships are inferred. The later arXiv submission date is retained as corroborating paper metadata rather than substituted for the earlier first-party public milestone.
